Language Efficiency

Tip: Non-Latin scripts usually cost more tokens for the same meaning. Writing system prompts in English can cut cost.

What is a token?

A token is a chunk of text an AI model reads. In English, 1 token is roughly 4 characters or ¾ of a word.

Why do other languages cost more?

Tokenizers are trained mostly on English, so Korean, Japanese, Chinese and many other languages split into more tokens for the same meaning.

Is my text private?

Yes. Everything runs locally in your browser. Your text is never sent to any server.

OpenAI models are counted with the o200k tokenizer. Claude and Gemini counts are estimates.

Prices are list rates per 1M tokens, last checked September 2026. Always confirm on the provider's pricing page.
